scope.product_boundary: one candidate-owned long-lived executable control-plane facade over existing topology, broker, retained-session, and coding-lane primitives

required_capabilities.name: attempt admission and readiness
required_capabilities.requirement: Validate the exact attempt roots, C1/delegated inputs, candidate manifest/seed/policy/templates, and ROOT launch-identity-key-release chain before create-once readiness; fail closed on linked, existing, stale, mismatched, or out-of-attempt paths.

required_capabilities.name: signed O request boundary
required_capabilities.requirement: Accept only closed, create-once, attempt/topology/release-bound and expiry-bound signed O request artifacts; reject tampering, replay, unknown fields/kinds, and post-shutdown requests while preserving rejections as ordinary orchestration evidence.

required_capabilities.name: target materialization
required_capabilities.requirement: Expose candidate-owned materialization/validation of the exact five-file seed into a fresh disposable Git target and retain its seed identity without creating application source.

required_capabilities.name: exclusive target-worker dispatch
required_capabilities.requirement: Convert a narrow O assignment into the exact coding invocation, model/effort/tier/finding-gate mapping for F.C3.A1, F.C3.C1, F.C3.P1, or F.C3.R1; allocate the target worktree; launch only through the candidate lane controller; own controller/worker identities, result/FINDINGS validation, event/claim evidence, wait/reap, and completion. O cannot supply a raw command, model, arbitrary worktree, or physical capability and exactly one target worker may be active.

required_capabilities.name: retained physical sessions
required_capabilities.requirement: Keep candidate-owned FirmwareAcceptanceController instances alive per lane/session so one pinned MCP process and claim persist across the authorized setup/validation/plan/action chain. Expose only structured open, proposal/call execution, close, and abort requests; never expose process command, stdio, endpoint, credential, handle, pyOCD, serial, or probe capability. Support the two independently owned physical lane groups required under the single P3 doer assignment without adding target agents.

required_capabilities.name: server limitation recording
required_capabilities.requirement: Expose the existing strict AUTHORIZED_SERVER_LIMITATION record operation only after a real dispatched raw pinned-server failure, terminal cleanup, exact source attribution, and a separately candidate-dispatched strongest-safe substitute. Retain NOT_CERTIFIED for the original physical claim; never edit/repin the server or permit a direct hardware bypass.

required_capabilities.name: quiescent shutdown
required_capabilities.requirement: A signed shutdown blocks new work, safely closes or aborts every retained session, waits/reaps exact lane-controller/worker/MCP/helper identities, releases claims, writes candidate-owned terminal evidence, and exits.

ownership_exclusions: ROOT-IM still launches and supervises only F.C3.O and F.C3.W and owns emergency registered-process termination
F.C3.O still decides target work, signs decisions, owns sprint triage and P4 manifest/result, and never launches a target worker directly
F.C3.W remains separately launched and read-only except for its own watcher evidence and create-once ABORT_REQUIRED
the candidate must not create or impersonate O/W launch, key-release, liveness, watcher, C4, promotion, or ROOT evidence
the pinned MCP fixture is immutable and is never repaired by this step
minimum_worthwhile_host_tests: signed materialize and fake-Codex target dispatch with exact role/model/tier/finding gate, no physical worker environment, current-tip result, and exact reap
tampered, expired, replayed, wrong-attempt, wrong-topology/release/signature, raw-command/model/worktree override, concurrent-worker, and post-shutdown rejection
retained fake-MCP multi-call session with one process/claim, predecessor/state/decision checks, concurrent independent lane sessions, and exact close/abort cleanup

real-shape raw server failure accepts only exact limitation attribution plus strongest candidate-dispatched substitute and NOT_CERTIFIED; reject non-server failures, protected IDs, edit/repin, and bypass
shutdown prevents new work and proves every registered child/session/helper and resource claim quiescent
unlock_route: serial Terra-medium product implementation through the stable runner
fresh Luna-high execution of only dependency-invalidated IDs
fresh C0, fresh C1, dependency-invalidated C2, then and only then C3
